description: Adds a SHA-256 fingerprint to the public register and returns a signed receipt with its position and time; the register is anchored daily in Bitcoin. Send only a fingerprint, never content or personal data: the register is public and permanent. Sealing proves the fingerprint existed at that time, not who made it. Free, rate-limited.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint as 64 lowercase hex characters, computed by you from your own content

name: symbolon_seal_fingerprint
title: Seal a fingerprint
